title: One app, three presentations, one state
caption: A prototype that runs entirely in the browser, with fictional data; CI installs, builds with type checks and publishes on GitHub Pages.

html.label: Initial HTML
html.note: The orbital scene is already in the HTML, with critical CSS; React and the intro carry it on with the same clock.

router.label: Router
router.note: Picks one of three presentations over the same data: classic, a navigable 3D universe or hybrid, with illustrations on 3D planes.

app.label: Events app
app.note: Catalogue, sign-up, pass and event builder. Signing up or checking in runs apart from the animations.

lazy.label: On demand
lazy.note: The GSAP intro, the QR library and the Excel reader download separately, when they are needed.

universe.label: 3D universe
universe.note: It lives outside the views and takes commands with an increasing ID: a new journey cancels the previous one. It only draws.

fallback.label: Static backdrop
fallback.note: If the download, a shader or the WebGL context fails, a static backdrop remains and every action keeps working.

ls.label: localStorage
ls.note: Stores events, bookings and check-ins. The migration keeps user-created events, and an old booking falls into the main session.
